# Pixel Painter

A simple offline pixel painting app built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Features
- 16x16 grid of paintable cells
- 6-color palette
- Eraser tool
- Clear button
- Live count of painted cells
- Fully keyboard accessible

## How to run
Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or internet connection required.

## Controls
- Click a color swatch to select it (or use keyboard: Tab to focus, Enter/Space to activate)
- Click a cell to paint it with the selected color
- Click the Eraser button to toggle eraser mode, then click cells to clear them
- Click Clear to reset the entire grid

## Keyboard support
- Tab through all controls
- Enter or Space activates focused buttons
- Visible focus outlines are provided

## Notes
- The app uses no external resources, imports, or network requests.
- Styling uses system fonts and a cohesive color palette.
- Layout is responsive and works down to 360px wide.
